questions.q: What does the test matrix's "boundary value" category specifically test?
options: The automation under the heaviest possible server load
A value sitting exactly at the edge of a condition, where > vs >= mistakes hide
Whether the automation has a user interface
The automation's total execution time
questions.explain: A boundary test (exactly 10%, for example) catches off-by-one mistakes that a mid-range happy-path test would never reveal.

questions.q: Why is a bulk test (such as 50 quotes updated via data import) included in the matrix?
options: It's the easiest test to run
Bulk tests replace the need for a happy-path test
Recursion and governor-limit problems typically only surface when many records change in one transaction
Salesforce requires bulk tests before activation
questions.explain: Single-record manual testing can hide problems that only appear when automation processes many records at once.

questions.q: According to this lesson, why does a quote entering approval when it shouldn't count as a test failure, even with no visible error?
options: Because Salesforce logs an error in that case regardless
Because it is not actually a failure in that case
Because any approval process entry is automatically a failure
Because "it ran" is not the same as "it ran correctly on the right record"
questions.explain: A passing test has to prove the automation did the right thing, not merely that it executed without throwing an exception.

questions.q: Where should every test in the four-category matrix be run?
options: Directly in production, since that's the only realistic data
In a sandbox or Developer Edition org, never production
It doesn't matter which environment is used
Only in a spreadsheet simulation
questions.explain: Testing means deliberately trying to break something, which production data is never the safe place to do.

questions.q: What tool confirms exactly which criteria evaluated true or false for a specific test record?
options: Debug logs
The company's annual report
A manually maintained spreadsheet
The Salesforce mobile app's notification center
questions.explain: Debug logs show the actual evaluated logic for a given record, which is how a boundary case gets confirmed rather than assumed.
